CustomField.description: Master-detail to the parent Form_Template__c. This page belongs to that template and is rendered as one step of its multi-page form; ownership and sharing are controlled by the parent. FormTemplate_Utility queries pages by this relationship (filtered by Hide Page and Visibility, ordered by Position) to build the runtime page list. Non-reparentable — a page cannot be moved to a different template after creation. Required, set when the page is created under a template.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This links the page to its parent Form Template and is set automatically when you create the page under a template. It is a master-detail relationship, so the page cannot be moved to another template later and it inherits the template's sharing; create a new page under the target template instead of trying to reparent.
CustomField.label: Form Template
